data.long_meaning: Man of Manz (god of power and victory). The name Manuchehr carries the meaning “Man of Victory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Manuchehr usually hope their child will grow to embody man of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Manuchehr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manuchehr total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
data.cultural_impact: The name "Manuchehr" is of Persian origin and holds significant cultural significance in the Muslim world. The name represents power, strength, and victory, qualities that are highly valued in many Muslim cultures. It is a name that is often given to boys in the hopes that they will grow up to be strong and successful leaders, achieving victory in all aspects of their lives. The name is also associated with the rich literary and artistic heritage of Persian culture, adding to its cultural appeal and prestige.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Manuchehr" lies in the assumption that the name implies a divine gift or blessing of power and victory. In Islamic belief, every person is created by Allah with unique blessings and abilities. By giving a child the name "Manuchehr," parents may be acknowledging and recognizing these blessings and asking for Allah's guidance and support in helping their child achieve his or her full potential, bringing honor to the family and the community. The name may also serve as a reminder for the child to strive for excellence and to use his or her God-given talents to make a positive impact in the world, ultimately leading to spiritual growth and reward in the Hereafter.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Man of Victory" symbolizes Man of Manz (god of power and victory). In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Manuchehr serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of man of victory.

historical_references.reference: Manuchehr was the name of the last independent ruler of the Timurid Empire in Transoxania. He ruled from 1500 to 1518.
Manuchehr was also known as Mirza Muhammad Haidar, and he was the founder of the Sheibani Dynasty in Herat. He ruled from 1510 to 1544.
historical_references.context: Founder of the Sheibani Dynasty in Herat
